feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub, Germany is recovering from its record low but remains far below normal
entry.summary: Germany's main shipping gauge read 16 centimetres on 11 October, up from the record low of minus 6 centimetres set on 1 October. — Sources: Kaub gauge readings, direct fetch via rivercruise.ai, 11 October 2026

entry.title: Phoenix, Arizona's longest triple-digit heat season on record is ending
entry.summary: Highs near 100°F eased toward the mid-to-upper 80s this weekend as moisture from Tropical Storm Rachel brought rain and wind into Arizona, closing out a season that reached 129 days of 100°F-or-higher heat, the fifth-most on record. — Sources: FOX10 Phoenix, 8 October 2026 · AZFamily, 7 October 2026

entry.title: Indonesia's fire-hotspot count reached its highest daily total of the year
entry.summary: Indonesia's Ministry of Forestry counted 24,952 fire hotspots nationally in the 24 hours to 8 October, up from 23,331 on 7 October and 21,708 on 6 October. — Sources: Indonesia Ministry of Forestry, via databoks.katadata.co.id, 8 October 2026

entry.title: Malaysia's haze stayed unhealthy in 38 areas even as its worst-hit town improved
entry.summary: Batu Pahat's air pollutant index eased from 203 on the evening of 6 October, when its schools closed, to 161 by 8 October. — Sources: Malay Mail, 8 October 2026 · The Star, 7 October 2026
